lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into identifiable horizontal rows and vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like nodal structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, showing high intensity above and shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency, small-diameter spot patterning in the cephalic region, transitioning into a lower-frequency pattern of larger blobs on the posterior flank.
